states.name: awaiting
states.prompt: Your {give_item} (worth {give_value} gp) for {receive_item} (worth {receive_value} gp). Need {shortage} more gp. Say 'yes' to accept, or offer extra gold.

states.name: countering
states.prompt: Still need {shortage} more gp. Offer more or say 'cancel'.

states.name: completed
states.prompt: Barter completed! You gave {give_item} and {paid_gold} gp, received {receive_item}.
